title: SPARC VORTEX vs NFW: analysis code and results
description: Reproducible analysis comparing a curl-free VORTEX dark-halo profile against the standard NFW profile on 171 SPARC galaxies. Corrected results (v2, fixed optimiser): VORTEX success rate 91.2% (156/171) vs NFW 80.1% (137/171) at chi2/dof < 3; median chi2/dof 0.552 vs 0.976; aggregate Delta BIC = +4196 in favour of VORTEX; head-to-head BIC wins 134/171. Note: v1 of this analysis (submitted 2026-09-21 to MNRAS) contained a systematic error in the NFW optimiser that did not converge for 54% of the sample; see erratum_note.pdf for full root-cause analysis.
references: Lelli F., McGaugh S. S., Schombert J. M., 2016, AJ, 152, 157
McGaugh S. S., Lelli F., Schombert J. M., 2016, PRL, 117, 201101
Navarro J. F., Frenk C. S., White S. D. M., 1996, ApJ, 462, 563
